messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm trying to prod deploy a small config bump but deploy-bot is blocking me with an MFA/role error. Can someone help with temporary elevation? I need to push v2026.3.1.
cheng: What error are you seeing?
maria: deploy-bot says: "Permission check failed: user not in group 'prod-deployers' and MFA not verified". My phone reset its auth app overnight.
sam: If it's just MFA, we can do a one-time escalation. Ping me and I'll approve, but we need the audit ticket created first. :lock:
maria: creating ticket now.
olivia: Reminder: if this touches DB migrations we need 2 approvers. Otherwise single approver + audit is fine.
maria: no DB work, just redis/cache TTL tweak.
cheng: OK. Confirming process: 1) confirm MFA re-enrolled, 2) role grant (temp), 3) pin version on deploy, 4) monitor canary and rollback threshold.
maria: re-registered MFA (Duo) — still getting the group error though.
sam: I'm granting a temporary role `prod-deployer-temp` for 1 hour. Audit note: ticket #4521.
sam: grant done — you should see `prod-deployer-temp` in the console.
maria: seeing it now, thanks. Trying the deploy command:```/deploy prod --version v2026.3.1 --notes "cache TTL tweak"```
deploy-bot: Deploy request received from maria. Build: 5432. Pinned version: v2026.3.1. Starting canary (2 nodes).
oncall-bot: Change window check: deploy within approved window until 10:00 UTC. Calendar: prod-deploy-windows.
cheng: Ping on observability hooks — please attach the trace id when deploy completes.
maria: canary logs look green initially, but deploy-bot: ERROR at 1763008005: 2/5 canary instances failing healthcheck, rolling back canary.
maria: ugh. rolling back to pinned v2026.2.9 now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by maria. Target version: v2026.2.9.
sam: Good rollback. Keep audit id: 0x7b4 in the ticket. We'll investigate why canaries failed (likely kernel driver or container runtime patch on that host pool).
cheng: I'll open a follow-up: investigate canary host pool and the real-time healthcheck logs.
maria: created issue #1223 with logs and the failing node ids.
olivia: Also add a note to the deploy runbook that MFA + SCIM sync can block newbies — small ops doc change.
sam: Role `prod-deployer-temp` revoked (auto-expire).
deploy-bot: Rollback completed. Current prod version: v2026.2.9.
maria: thanks everyone. Lessons: re-enroll MFA earlier, always pin a safe rollback version, and confirm canary host pool health before launching.
cheng: Agreed. I'll follow up with a pre-deploy host health check step in the pipeline.
olivia: +1. Closing thread when postmortem item is created. :white_check_mark:
